items.title: Three innings defeats in four days: Another Bangladesh side outplayed
items.summary: The Emerging team, however, put up a relatively better fight, taking the match into the fourth and final day. But the outcome appeared almost certain after the third day, when Bangladesh finished on 94 for three in their second innings while following on.

items.title: Starc goes past Bumrah to top Test bowling rankings for the first time
items.summary: Mitchell Starc returned figures of 6 for 12 and 4 for 39 in Australia's innings win over Bangladesh in Mackay

items.title: Starc dethrones Bumrah to claim No. 1 Test ranking
items.summary: Jasprit Bumrah's tenure as the No.1 ranked Test bowler is over as Australia pacer Mitchell Starc claimed the premier position for the first time in his illustrious career on the back of his dominant performance against Bangladesh.

items.title: Lyon’s Australia future spins into doubt after Bangladesh series
items.summary: With Nathan Lyon almost as iconic in Australian cricket as the baggy green cap worn by the nation's test players, selectors face a delicate task in managing a proud spinner whose role may be curtailed amid changing priorities.

items.title: Tigers set for Afghanistan series in October
items.summary: While Bangladesh’s series against India in September remains in limbo, the Tigers have red-ball and white-ball assignments to look forward to in October. Bangladesh are set to face Afghanistan in the UAE in a series featuring one Test and three white-ball matches.

items.title: Batting woes deepen as Bangladesh A crumble to an innings and 413-run defeat against South Africa A
items.summary: Bangladesh A’s batting woes continued as they slumped to a massive innings-and-413-run defeat against South Africa A in the opening four-day match at LC de Villiers Oval in Pretoria on Tuesday.

items.title: Late collapse hands Bangladesh HP first defeat in Top End T20 Series
items.summary: The high-flying Bangladesh High Performance team suffered their first defeat of the Top End T20 Series, falling to the Adelaide Strikers Academy by 21 runs at Darwin's Marrara Cricket Ground on Tuesday.

items.title: Shanto hopes Bangladesh 'do it' in South Africa after Darwin conquest
items.summary: "I don't want to point finger at anyone in particular but we played poorly as a team," Shanto said after the two-day loss in Mackay

items.title: Shanto wants more SENA Tests after Bangladesh rise to No. 6 in rankings
items.summary: Bangladesh drew their first series in Australia in 23 years, and rose above No. 9 on the ICC Test rankings for the first time

items.title: Starc claims 10 to demolish Bangladesh in two days
items.summary: It became the second-shortest Test ever played on Australian soil after Bangladesh were bundled for 95 on the second day

items.title: Six for Starc, six for Shoriful, Australia in front after 18-wicket opening day
items.summary: Bangladesh were knocked over in just 34 overs for 64 but fought back to leave Australia eight down - though 101 runs in front - by the end of the first day

items.title: How Starc completed his five-wicket haul in 22 balls
items.summary: The left-arm quick dismantled Bangladesh's top order on the opening day in Mackay

items.title: Australia bowl first on Mackay's Test debut; Shoriful in for Bangladesh
items.summary: After surprising many by batting first in Darwin, Australia's captain went the opposite way in the second Test

items.title: Confident Shanto plots 'five days of good cricket again'
items.summary: Bangladesh captain Najmul Hossain Shanto believes his side can cope with the extra bounce in Mackay, the venue of the second Test against Australia

items.title: Lyon survives selection call as Renshaw locked in to open
items.summary: Jake Weatherald, who had opened with Travis Head in the first Test against Bangladesh, was dropped from the squad prior to the second Test, which starts on Saturday in Mackay

items.title: Bangladesh eye more history with only one result on Australia's mind
items.summary: Bangladesh did the unthinkable in Darwin, and will have to do it all over again if they want to convert the Test match win to a Test series win
